description: This file defines a React component 'TasksDashboard' for managing and displaying tasks within a task management system. It includes functionalities for listing, filtering, creating, editing, deleting, and toggling the status of tasks, with integrations for API calls, authentication, and user notifications.

methods.name: statusLabel
methods.description: Converts a TaskStatus into a human-readable label.

methods.name: statusTone
methods.description: Returns UI tone styling based on task status.

methods.name: priorityTone
methods.description: Returns UI tone styling based on task priority.

methods.name: nextStatus
methods.description: Determines the next status for a task, used for toggling.

methods.name: matchTask
methods.description: Filters tasks based on a search query matching title, description, status, or priority.
